audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows are inverted against their own reasons. Both layers read Neeko / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Neeko / Pantheon / Pantheon, while whys[0] calls Level 1 'the hardest level-1 in the game' for Pantheon, whys[2] and whys[3] describe contested stages, and whys[5] and whys[6] say Neeko's item spike deletes him and she 'keeps the duel and the lane all the way through'. The packet chart (Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko) matches every reason, and matches the 61.11% win rate. The header compounded it: TRICKY 7/10 with a 7.5/10 carry threat on a lane the page itself says Neeko wins outright after one item.
audit.why: Pantheon is the archetypal front-loaded lane bully who falls off — the page's prose knows this and its chart says the opposite, handing him first item and two items while telling the reader his kit stops scaling.
audit.corrected: Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Neeko as matched full+content pairs with ratings; diff TRICKY -> FAVOURED, tone to green, diffRating 7/10 -> 4.5/10, carryRating 7.5/10 -> 6/10, and both rating lines rewritten.

audit.why: Four spikes, correct timings, and they tell the true arc: his Level 1-2 all-in, her Level 3 root answer, her Level 6 flip, and her first-item takeover. The mirror recorded no spike changes from Pantheon's side either.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the passive claim inside spikes[2].text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) WRONG PASSIVE, five places. whys[0], whys[4], spikes[2].text, early, mid and wants.foe[1] all say Mortal Will 'blocks your Q autos' or 'blocks the first auto from any direction'. Mortal Will does nothing of the kind — per Riot's text it empowers his next spell every few spells or attacks. The auto-blocking passive was removed from Pantheon years ago; the page is coaching against a champion that no longer exists. (b) MISSING, and it is the best line available in this matchup: Aegis Assault (E) is a CHANNEL. Tangle-Barbs or Pop Blossom cancels it outright, and it is 22s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his kit. Nothing on the page mentions it. (c) MISSING: while Aegis Assault runs he is invulnerable to damage from the front, so a burst dumped into a raised shield is simply deleted. (d) MISSING: Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step back.
audit.why: Believing in the auto-block makes the player avoid melee for the wrong reason and, worse, tells them his shield beats skillshots when in fact the shield is the thing their skillshot beats. Cancelling a 22s channel with a 12s root is a free trade every rotation and the page never offers it.
audit.corrected: Mortal Will empowers his next spell — the empowered Comet Spear (575 range, 11s at rank 1) is the damage, not a block. Aegis Assault (400 range, 22/21/20/19/18s) is invulnerability from the front only, and it is a channel: your root or your ult cancels it. Shield Vault (600 range, 13/12/11/10/9s) is a point-and-click dash-stun with an auto reset — read the wind-up.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges, cooldowns and flags (channel, untargetable, shield, autoReset)

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Shield Vault as the only cooldown worth tracking. The far more punishable one is Aegis Assault at 22s.
audit.why: Shield Vault returns every 13s at rank 1; Aegis Assault takes 22s and is his entire defensive answer to a burst mage. Cancelling or waiting it out is what creates the kill window at 6.
audit.corrected: Repointed dosFull[2] at the Aegis Assault channel and its 22s.

edits.before: Pantheon owns the first two levels outright: his point-click W stun lets him jump on you for an empowered Q spear, and his passive blocks the first auto from any direction, so you cannot just stat-check him with Q autos at melee. Don't step up for greedy last-hits at levels 1-2 -- take Q on the wave with the tip and concede a little CS. Your turn comes at 3: with Q and E (Tangle-Barbs) you can root him as his W stun wears off and poke him while he can't block a skillshot with his shield.
edits.after: Pantheon owns the first two levels outright: his point-click W stun lets him jump on you for a Mortal Will empowered Comet Spear, and Aegis Assault leaves him invulnerable from the front for the whole channel, so you cannot stat-check him at melee. Don't step up for greedy last-hits at levels 1-2 -- take Q on the wave with the tip and concede a little CS. Your turn comes at 3: with Q and E (Tangle-Barbs) you root him as the W stun wears off, and that same root cancels Aegis Assault outright.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 trend even -- you farm with Q waveclear and chip him, but you won't all-in without ult, and he still has his W-stun-into-spear burst. Hold your aggression for 6. Pop Blossom (R) is the lane-flipper: bait his W with your own W clone/invisibility, land E to lock him, then R for the stun-and-burst -- an itemless Pantheon has no sustain and his passive can't block your AoE combo, so it's a kill or a flash.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 trend even -- you farm with Q waveclear and chip him, but you won't all-in without ult, and he still has his W-stun-into-spear burst. Hold your aggression for 6. Pop Blossom (R) is the lane-flipper: bait his W with your own W clone/invisibility, land E to lock him, then R for the stun-and-burst -- an itemless Pantheon has no sustain, and if he raises Aegis Assault your root cancels the channel, so it's a kill or a flash.

notes: The single most valuable correction here is the passive. Mortal Will has not blocked autos for years — Riot's own text is 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered' — yet six strings coach around an auto-block. Anyone playing to that model avoids melee for the wrong reason and, critically, believes his defensive tool beats their skillshots when the opposite is true: Aegis Assault is a channel their 12s root cancels. The mirror audit (pantheon__neeko) reported the names on that page were already correct and its work was mechanics; that does not hold on this side. One judgement call flagged rather than acted on: I did not touch dosFull[0]/dontsFull[0], which talk about baiting his dash — unlike olaf and ornn, Pantheon genuinely has dashes on W and R, so the boilerplate happens to be true here.
